title: Save a chapter for printing
description: Use the reader menu to save the current chapter as a local PDF.
steps: Open More and choose Save chapter PDF.
Wait for the saved-file confirmation.
The external PDF viewer is not shown in this recording.

title: Save an ordered PDF packet
description: Use the app�s command field to combine two existing chapter PDFs in a chosen order.
steps: Start with two chapter PDFs already saved.
Type their names in order using the packet command.
Save the combined PDF; the external viewer is not shown.

title: Make a Word reading sheet
description: Choose a passage, create a Word reading sheet, and preview the saved file inside the workbench.
steps: Open Documents and choose Passage as the source.
Type a reference and make a Reading Sheet.
Open the saved document’s in-app preview.

title: Preview a document Look
description: Adjust type size and spacing while viewing a preview of the source-backed document.
steps: Choose a passage and open Adjust.
Change the type size and line spacing.
Apply the appearance choices to the export.

title: Make PDF and PowerPoint slides
description: Export an existing passage as PDF slides, inspect a slide, and make an editable PowerPoint copy.
steps: Choose a passage and the Reader structure.
Make PDF slides and preview the next slide.
Choose PowerPoint with PDF preview and make the editable file.

title: Choose the content to export
description: Inspect the existing blocks in a sample page, turn one off, and preview the selected content.
steps: Choose a sample page in Documents.
Review what goes in and turn off a paragraph.
Open the Word preview for the selected content.

title: Keep a saved document up to date
description: Stop tracking a sample export, resume tracking, and remake it from the source.
steps: Open the saved document’s actions.
Stop keeping it up to date, then resume.
Make the document again from its source.
